Portable Speaker Karaoke System for Home

Bring your home karaoke nights to life with a compact, wireless Bluetooth karaoke system designed for singing and fun with family and friends.

Bluetooth Karaoke System with Dual Mics and Phone Holder

Enjoy hassle-free karaoke at home with dual wireless mics, vocal cancellation, and a smartphone holder for duet singing without interruptions.

Portable Karaoke System for Home

Turn Every Gathering into a Fun-Filled Karaoke Party! Your perfect partner for house parties, family karaoke, and hands-free content viewing. Enjoy wireless mics, hands-free singing, and powerful audio. Perfect for family fun or solo performances.

Hit play and unleash the fun!

Discover the perfect party companion! Watch this video to see how the KTV Karaoke Speaker transforms your home into a fun-filled stage. From dual wireless microphones for duets to its hands-free phone holder and AI-powered voice changers, this speaker is your all-in-one entertainment system.

Sing Your Heart Out with Duet Mode

Wireless dual microphones make duets seamless and fun, perfect for family or party nights.

Standalone Speaker with a Smartphone Holder

Enjoy your favorite shows, movies, or sports hands-free with crystal-clear speaker audio

Hands-Free Karaoke Without Forgetting the Lyrics!

Built-in phone holder keeps lyrics in view while you focus on enjoying the music. Simply play the song of your choice with the karaoke lyrics and slide your phone in!

Turn Any Song into a Karaoke Track

Remove vocals from any song in seconds and create your own karaoke playlist

5 Fun Voice Effects for Every Mood

Switch between Baby, Monster, Male, Female, or Natural voice with a press of a button
